map.为什么权限用三位八进制？: Why are permissions written as three octal digits?
map.因为 Unix 权限正好分三组（属主、属组、其他），每组用 rwx 三个位表示，: Because Unix permissions fall into exactly three groups (owner, group, other), each represented by three rwx bits, which is exactly one octal digit (0–7): 4=read, 2=write, 1=execute, combined by addition. So 0644 means the owner can read and write (6=4+2) while group and other can only read (4). The leading 0 is the octal literal prefix, not a permission bit.
